intended_object: The i-th root subgroup (a copy of the additive group scheme 𝔾ₐ over ℤ, given by t ↦ exp(t·ρ(e_i)) acting on the Kostant ℤ-lattice M) as a closed subgroup scheme of the "toral closure" group scheme. That group scheme is the closed subgroup of GL(M) generated by the root subgroups and the weight torus. This is the root-subgroup part of a pinning in the Chevalley–Demazure construction (Humphreys §26, Carter §4.4). Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
